about_the_game:
Wandering Within is a survival game in which you must cross a hostile desert to unravel the mysteries of a legendary chest.

Find water, food and warmth, as the nights will be freezing. Build a variety of tools and find your way through an environment that will do anything to lose you.

Discover a universe rich in legends, strange places and characters who will guide you on your quest.

DEMO CONTENT

  • Survive by managing your hunger, thirst and temperature. Death is final

  • Tool-making system

  • The desert is dotted with 4 different biomes and lakes. Random generation

  • 2 notable places and a desert dweller to meet

  • Navigation quest: find a notable point by following directions. Orientation is key.

  • Snippets of the legend to collect

COMING IN THE FINAL GAME

  • An additional biome

  • 5 additional characters

  • 6 other notable locations

  • 4 animal species to cross paths with

  • New crafts and items

  • The complete legend and the mystery of the chest to solve
